notes: Full-table assets only; app integration belongs to the later consumer.
This boardless game has no fixed card capacity or physical score track; full player stations and variable ordered card layout semantics are supplied instead.
The 2-player variant is explicitly distinct. Cards excluded for player count and the conditional 22-card reserve must never be mistaken for an active draw deck.
The source PDF is Oink-authored but retailer-hosted; official Oink product/errata page independently confirms the edition and core card-hand structure.

structureEvidence.verifiedFacts: Components, all-player setup, ordered/dual-ended hands, current Show ownership, captured cards, Scout and Scout & Show chips, score-chip piles, starting marker, and 2-player reserved second-round cards.

componentInventory.scoutSupplyPolicy: not a gameplay cap; rules allow replacement coins if the physical Scout chips run out

cardState.meaning: The two printed values stay with the same physical card. Capture identities/ends only when visible or owner-authorized.

roundTwoReserve.visibility: hidden; only applicable in two-player mode

hand.algorithm: For n cards, cardWidth=min(60,availableHeight*2/3); step=min(cardWidth, max(0,(availableWidth-cardWidth)/max(1,n-1))); place in stored order without re-sorting. Use scrolling/zoom when the visible top-end bands become too small.
hand.orientation: A setup whole-hand 180° flip is distinct from a Scouted card’s individually chosen orientation.

activeSet.algorithm: Keep source order; scale equal-size card instances to fit the available row. Leftmost/rightmost card IDs are the Scout endpoints. Do not fabricate a four-card set from the guide illustration.

checkpointSemantics: Standard 3–5 player turns are clockwise; Show replaces the Active Set and captures the previous set face-down.
Scout removes one endpoint card, permits either orientation and any hand insertion point, and retains the prior Active Set owner while any cards remain.
Scout & Show is a once-per-player-per-round token; preserve whether it has moved to the shared used pool.
The 2-player variant uses 3 Scout chips per player, no Scout & Show chip, and a hidden 22-card reserve for round two. Preserve its distinct turn/checkpoint state.
At a round boundary preserve captured-card counts, Scout chips, remaining hand count, round result, score-chip faces/signs and the next starting player; do not infer a score merely from a token icon.
